pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, leaf-like polygonal dark regions with soft-to-moderate edge gradients. Patches on the central flank are significantly larger than the smaller, more densely packed patches on the hind limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a topological grid. Junction nodes typically connect 3-4 pathways. The thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-flank but shows slight narrowing toward the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane along the upper neck exhibiting a fine-grained, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian subject, likely an oxpecker, perched on the upper dorsal-lateral region of the neck.
